definitions.explanation: An adult male human. Also used as a prefix to indicate male gender of various things.

examples.japanese: あの{男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}は{田中|たなか}さんです。
examples.notes: 男の人 is more polite than 男 alone

examples.japanese: {男|おとこ}の{子|こ}が{二人|ふたり}、{女|おんな}の{子|こ}が{一人|ひとり}います。
examples.english: There are two boys and one girl.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{男|おとこ}らしい{人|ひと}です。

notes: When referring to people politely, use {男|おとこ}の{人|ひと} (man) or {男性|だんせい} (male, more formal). {男|おとこ}の{子|こ} means 'boy'. The kanji {男|おとこ} is also read as だん in compounds like {男性|だんせい}. Opposite: {女|おんな} (woman).
